# Dan Mullin

> Personal site for Dan Mullin — tools, games, and systems you can play with.

danmull.in is a lobby for projects: an AI-native programming language, SVG and map tools, a music visualizer, and games in progress. The public MCP at `/mcp` can list projects and read markdown pages. There is no OAuth or checkout on this origin.

## Pages

- [Home](https://danmull.in/): Project lobby
- [Synth](https://danmull.in/synth): AI-native language with a real compiler
- [Games](https://danmull.in/games): Harborwick, Ledger Bay, and playables

## Projects

- [Synth](https://synth-pl.github.io/synth/): Language home — demos, docs, playground
- [Synth source](https://github.com/synth-pl/synth): Compiler, demos, VS Code extension path
- [Penultimate](https://danmullin.github.io/penultimate/): SVG vector editor
- [Tileforge](https://danmullin.github.io/tileforge/): Map authoring and tile studio
- [Onion Lab](https://danmullin.github.io/onion-lab/): Spritesheet animation studio
- [Sunwake](https://danmullin.github.io/sunwake/): Music visualizer
- [GitHub](https://github.com/danmullin): Repos and work in the open
